identity.age_range: примерно 25–35 лет по внешнему виду (оценка, не биографический факт)
identity.face_description: Взрослый мужчина с овально-угловатым лицом, умеренно выраженными скулами и прямым носом, густыми тёмными бровями, небольшой естественной асимметрией формы губ (выражение лица меняется от сцены к сцене), естественной текстурой кожи, тёмными усами и короткой щетиной. Глаза на исходных изображениях выглядят от коричнево-ореховых до серо-зелёных при разном освещении; точный канонический оттенок ещё не утверждён.
identity.hair: Густые тёмно-каштановые волосы средней длины, естественно волнистые/кудрявые, объёмная небрежная укладка, несколько локонов на лбу.
identity.body_type: Ранние мудборды: атлетичное/стройное телосложение (концептуальная характеристика, не доказательство роста).
distinctive_features: Густые волнистые тёмно-каштановые волосы с прядями, опускающимися на лоб
Форма глаз и густые брови визуально стабильны; точный цвет глаз требует отдельного утверждения
Небольшая естественная асимметрия формы губ; улыбка и мимика не являются фиксированными признаками идентичности

primary_visual_candidate.purpose: anchor for anatomical facial identity, not pose, lighting, expression or wardrobe

facial_identity_spec.facial_structure: Moderately elongated oval-angular face, defined but not exaggerated cheekbones, moderately broad chin with a softly angular jaw; do not narrow jaw or replace face with juvenile/delicate features.
facial_identity_spec.nose: Predominantly straight nose and consistent bridge/tip proportions relative to reference; reject changes in nose width or projection that alter identity.
facial_identity_spec.eyebrows: Distinctively thick, dark, broadly straight brows with gentle curvature.
facial_identity_spec.eyes: Preserve eye shape, eyelid geometry and spacing relative to reference; precise iris shade is unresolved and must not be asserted as fixed.
facial_identity_spec.lips: Preserve natural lip proportions and slight resting asymmetry; smile, half-smile and expression are NOT identity anchors.
facial_identity_spec.hair: Dense, dark chestnut, medium-length wavy-curly hair with irregular ringlets across forehead; exact strand placement can vary.
facial_identity_spec.facial_hair: Visible dark moustache plus short, uneven stubble along cheeks, jaw and chin; modest grooming variation permitted, but do not remove beard or change facial structure.
facial_identity_spec.skin: Natural pores, light freckles and small skin irregularities; no plastic beauty retouching, no exaggerated artificial defects.
facial_identity_spec.physique: Lean athletic impression from conceptual boards; exact height, dimensions and age not established by photographs.

generation_reference_rules: Before generation, load the PRIMARY FULL-RESOLUTION IMAGE into the actual image provider as image-conditioned reference when supported; a text description or reading the file in chat is not proof of conditioning.
Record whether the provider genuinely received the reference. If unconfirmed, label generation identity_unverified; do not claim likeness was preserved.
Do not use the rejected October 9 cafe experiments as canonical visual references.
Do not lock expression, head angle or original cafe setting; action, hands, gaze and light must follow the new scene.
Compare new independent single-frame images with primary original for facial structure, brows, eyes, nose, jaw, lips, hair and stubble before owner acceptance.

last_experiment_outcome.observation: Repeated cafe outputs improved pose realism but changed jaw/nose and reduced facial hair; identity continuity not validated.

approval_requirements: Owner explicitly approves full-resolution primary portrait as canonical facial anchor.
At least two further independent single-frame scenes with verified reference conditioning pass comparative visual identity review before claiming multi-scene consistency.

production.first_test: single character identity reference and repeated natural scene generations
